sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Burt Lake State Park resources via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2027-05-18, 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (same on 2027-05-18, 06-15 and 09-21): 20/30-amp sites $43 (195 sites), 50-amp sites $48 (109). The DNR's 2026 rate table listed $41 / $46. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($43 for the 20/30-amp sites, $48 for the 50-amp sites, 2027-05-18 / 2027-06-15 / 2027-09-21) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/burtlake ('Recreation Passport required ... for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ site attributes (109 sites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps', 195 sites '20 Amps/30 Amps'; every site 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/burtlake ('either 20/30-amp or 50-amp service throughout the campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 306 sites in the East and West loops (the booking site lists 304 campsites). Equipment lists run to 'Trailer or RV up to 40''. Sites within view of Burt Lake are large and sunny; the rest are shaded by oaks, maples and pines.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/burtlake ('Number of sites: 306', 'Pull-through sites available', 'Campsites within view of Burt Lake are large and sunny') + midnrreservations.com equipment lists per site, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sanitation station (two lanes, potable water) in the modern campground, registered campers only.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/burtlake (amenities 'Toilet & shower building, Vault toilet, Sanitation station, Concession or store'; 'The park's sanitation station is in the modern campground. There is potable water available and two lanes'; 'unable to offer sanitation station access to non-registered campers'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/burtlake ('Burt Lake Modern Campground: For reservations call 231-238-9392 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: DNR park page + booking site: 306 sites, 20/30 A everywhere and 50 A at 109, electric only (no water or sewer at sites), equipment to 40 ft, pull-throughs, showers/vault toilets/sanitation station/store, reservable online or by phone (231-238-9392, matches). Fees 41-46 (2026 DNR table) -> 43-48 (2027 booking site). Season May 15 - Oct 14 already manual. No closure notice. --AWH note kept unchanged.
flags: Missing operator website: the entry links only the bare reservation home page (https://midnrreservations.com/); the park's DNR page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/burtlake. Phone 231-238-9392 matches DNR.
